messages:
Nia: FYI i pushed a draft cheatsheet for export field mapping + retention edge cases to the PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4621
Nia: main goal: a one-page table that helps integrators map export.v1 -> export.v2 fields and flags for retention behavior
Ravi: nice. can you include the `created_by` -> `actor_id` rename and note the new `export_metadata` wrapper? a tiny example helps
Nia: added a short JSON snippet under the table showing `created_by` -> `actor_id` and `meta` flattened into `export_metadata`
Tess: please add the "when retention overrides apply" bullets (tenant TTL vs org policy vs manual deletion). i've seen confusion in support tickets
Nia: added three bullets: tenant TTL, org-level minimum retention, and manual-admin deletions. clarified the priority order
legal-ops: language check: replace "we delete immediately" phrasing. prefer "deletion requests are processed within the configured SLA window" and include link to deletion SLA doc
Nia: updated phrasing: "Deletion requests are processed according to the configured retention and deletion SLA; plaintext export artifacts are not retained beyond the effective retention period." added link to /policies/data-deletion
Ravi: small nit on the example curl response: it still shows `download_url` as http. pls use https + short expiry note
Nia: fixed curl; added note: "URLs expire per tenant export policy (default 24h)"
Omar: can we also mention the recommended pattern for streaming large exports (use paged exports + S3 transfer) so customers avoid client OOMs? one-liner is fine
Nia: added a one-liner and linked to the export streaming guide in infra docs
docs-bot: @Nia staging preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/exports/field-mapping-cheatsheet.html CI checks: passed :white_check_mark:
Tess: will skim and approve. if nothing else i'll merge after legal sign-off
legal-ops: approved the wording update. okay to merge from legal side
Nia: thanks everyone. merging once tess gives final OK :rocket:
